contexts.text: Such a disagreement of the interiors and exteriors... They know nothing whatever about such a disagreement... AC 8383:end. SE 594:end.
Not yet so far advanced in the truth of faith as to take away the disagreements within the Church. Signified.
When there comes forth any slight disagreement among (the Spirits of Jupiter)... These are the signs of the disagreement: but the disagreement among them is quickly adjusted. SE 614.
It treats... of the disagreements (during temptations) between the evils and falsities which are from Hell, and the goods and truths which are from the Lord.
They who cause disagreements and enmities among others... in order to rule. SE 1802.
He sowed disagreements from intestine hatred...
The Word not understood, whence come disagreements in the Church. Signified.
That there will no longer be a disagreement between the internal and the external man. Signified. AE 365:41.
That there will be a disagreement between good and truth, and between truth and good. Signified.
That there will no longer be any disagreement between truths and falsities, and between goods and evils. Signified.
Truth from Heaven acts into the understanding, and at the same time falsity from Hell; hence there takes place a tearing asunder in the mind...
2a [end]. Hence come heresies, disagreements... of differing dogmas in the Church.
